recommendation: Keep this targeted fix. If a full FHIR ModelInfo library regeneration is desired to remove all remaining legacy medication-definition class names, handle it as a separate computable-model maintenance task with explicit review.
issue_request: FHIR-16945 was a Published BRR change request raised against STU3 for R5, asking to collapse the growing MedicinalProduct/Substance definition resource set. Its final resolution was Not Persuasive with Modification because later medication-definition development and FMG approval had overtaken the original request.
initial_application: No commit explicitly mentioning FHIR-16945 was found. The practical application was the later R4B/R5 medication-definition redesign, especially commit e45413f7a7c4825937ad64d7800f54ff8ae3e0f2, which removed or commented old MedicinalProduct/Substance resources, added the current Medication Definition module, and kept MedicinalProductDefinition, PackagedProductDefinition, AdministrableProductDefinition, Ingredient, ClinicalUseDefinition, and SubstanceDefinition as the active model.
additional_context: Current fhir.ini and module narrative already reflect the approved resource-family model and say implementations can use the subset of definition resources they need. The remaining safe current-build residue was localized: the old MedicinalProductPharmaceutical mapping had a misspelled target, and MarketingStatus examples still referenced retired MedicinalProductPackaged examples. Existing combined-branch commits for FHIR-28431 and FHIR-31792 show that broader FHIR ModelInfo legacy-name cleanup is being handled by specific tracker-scoped changes rather than an unbounded generated-model rewrite here.
reconciliation: Changed source/fhir.ini so MedicinalProductPharmaceutical maps to AdministrableProductDefinition, and changed source/marketingstatus-examples.html to direct readers to current MedicinalProductDefinition and PackagedProductDefinition examples.
source_changes: source/fhir.ini: corrected MedicinalProductPharmaceutical=-> AdministrableProductDefinition in the R4-R6 change map.
source/marketingstatus-examples.html: replaced the stale MedicinalProductPackaged examples reference with current MedicinalProductDefinition and PackagedProductDefinition examples.
